cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

mechanism: A treats its former hosting pupil details about a visitor tea as a test of remembered hospitality while circling the visitor identity without naming the target question.
confusable: Not directly asking who visited with decorative phrasing: A asks only cup, sugar and milk facts while B identifies the concealed identity question.
comparison: Tea preference clues versus travel timetable clues.
